title: Sparkly bowl of noodles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles around the bowl -->
  <g fill='#FFE066'>

    <path d='M82 18 L84 23 L89 25 L84 27 L82 32 L80 27 L75 25 L80 23 Z'/>

    <circle cx='70' cy='10' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='36' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='8' cy='38' r='2'/>

  <g stroke='#FFE27A' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M33 55 Q29 46 35 40 Q41 34 37 28'/>
    <path d='M45 55 Q41 46 47 38 Q53 30 49 24'/>
    <path d='M57 55 Q61 46 55 38 Q51 32 57 26'/>
    <path d='M69 55 Q73 48 67 42 Q63 36 69 30'/>
  </g>

  <!-- egg -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='50' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#FFF3D6'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='50' rx='8' ry='6' fill='none' stroke='#F0D9A0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#FFB300'/>

  <g fill='#7EE08A'>

    <ellipse cx='56' cy='48' rx='2.5' ry='1.8'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#4FBF63'>
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='52' rx='1.2' ry='0.8'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='49' rx='1.2' ry='0.8'/>
    <ellipse cx='56' cy='48' rx='1' ry='0.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- bowl body -->
  <path d='M22 54 Q20 76 36 84 Q50 88 64 84 Q80 76 78 54 Z' fill='#E85D5D'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='29' ry='7' fill='#FF7B7B'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='29' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#FFB3B3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- inner rim shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='23' ry='5' fill='#C94A4A'/>

  <!-- bowl decoration band -->
  <path d='M24 66 Q50 74 76 66' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 72 Q50 79 74 72' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bowl foot -->
  <rect x='40' y='84' width='20' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#C94A4A'/>
  <rect x='40' y='84' width='20' height='2' rx='1' fill='#E85D5D'/>

  <!-- noodle ends hanging over the rim -->
  <g stroke='#F5C242' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M30 54 Q27 60 29 64'/>
    <path d='M70 54 Q73 59 71 64'/>
  </g>
